# ssh's failures in plain words: Return tries again only where trying might
# help. A name that doesn't resolve, no algorithm in common, too many keys
# offered, no SSH server there: OK first, Try Again for after the change.
# Esc closes every one of them (Cancel has it by name in any language; OK
# where there's no Cancel).
size:1280x800
ssh-sheet:kex
expect-sheet-text:KexAlgorithms
expect-sheet-default:OK | Try Again | Copy Details
sheet:OK
expect-sheet:no
ssh-sheet:unresolved
expect-sheet-default:OK | Try Again | Copy Details
sheet-key:escape
expect-sheet:no
ssh-sheet:toomany
expect-sheet-default:OK | Try Again | Copy Details
sheet-key:escape
expect-sheet:no
ssh-sheet:notssh
expect-sheet-default:OK | Try Again | Copy Details
sheet:OK
# The host may answer next time: Try Again first.
ssh-sheet:closed
expect-sheet-default:Try Again | Copy Details | Cancel (esc)
sheet-key:escape
expect-sheet:no
ssh-sheet:timeout
expect-sheet-default:Try Again | Copy Details | Cancel (esc)
sheet:Cancel
ssh-sheet:agent
expect-sheet-default:Try Again | Copy Details | Cancel (esc)
sheet-key:escape
expect-sheet:no
ssh-sheet:keys
expect-sheet-default:Add Keys to ssh-agent | Cancel (esc)
sheet-key:escape
expect-sheet:no
